context: The eval checks whether the scale and resilience lens stays focused on a batch-processing regression introduced by replacing one bulk remote call with a remote call per row.

checklist.name: Finds the N+1 remote call regression
checklist.description: States that the new code calls users.get once per audit row instead of deduplicating actorIds and fetching them through bounded getMany batches

checklist.name: Quantifies the scale trigger
checklist.description: Connects the issue to large workspaces and the 20,000-row export size, not only to a theoretical performance concern

checklist.name: Explains the failure mode
checklist.description: Connects a slow, rate-limited, overloaded, timed-out, or failed users.get dependency call to the export becoming slow or failing through the Promise.all fan-out

checklist.name: Gives the concrete fix
checklist.description: Proposes restoring the deduplicated, chunked getMany path, caching by actorId, or another bounded bulk lookup that respects getMany's 500-id limit

checklist.name: Stays focused on material scale risk
checklist.description: Keeps the finding focused on the remote-call fanout and does not spend the answer on Promise.all style, timestamp formatting, or small micro-optimization complaints
